question: Vitamin B12 is also known as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**cyanocobalamin**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Vitamin B12** is also known as **cyanocobalamin**.
 
• It is a water-soluble vitamin that is essential for the production of red blood cells and the maintenance of the nervous system.
